field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: ID economic nexus gross receipts threshold: $100,000 (primarily for sales tax)

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: ID does not use transaction count for corporate income tax nexus

field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: ID uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor)

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: ID corporate income tax rate: 5.3% flat rate (effective 2025) - Idaho Code § 63-3025

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: ID additions: state income taxes deducted federally, certain expenses, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: ID subtractions: U.S. government interest, Idaho municipal bond interest, state NOL, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: ID tax credits: investment tax credit, R&D credit, broadband equipment credit, etc.
